objective: Map already-normalized Telnyx voice lifecycle evidence into deterministic canonical contact-attempt reconciliation decisions without webhook transport, persistence writes, provider-event receipt mutation, or bridge runtime execution.
operatorFirstSafety: call.answered does not prove the lead is connected because it may represent the operator leg.
call.bridged is the first normalized Telnyx event treated as canonical connected evidence.
call.hangup completes an active canonical attempt but does not by itself imply provider failure.
idempotency: Repeated bridged evidence against connected or terminal state is a no-op.
Repeated hangup evidence against completed or other terminal state is a no-op.
Out-of-order initiated or answered evidence never regresses canonical state.
identity: The canonical attempt must already be resolved by provider plus call_control_id before this planner is invoked.
Planner rejects a non-Telnyx attempt provider.
Planner rejects mismatched attempt providerReference and normalized callControlId.
failurePolicy: Do not infer canonical failed state from hangup_cause, hangup_source, or sip_hangup_cause.
A later explicitly modeled provider-failure evidence path may transition active attempts to failed with structured canonical failure fields.
next: INS-002E2B4 designs durable reconciliation execution ordering around provider-reference lookup, canonical attempt update, and provider-event receipt deduplication.
